title: Branch cleanup reconnect-safe progress delivery
progress_summary: Issue #4433 delivered. Branch cleanup progress and results now carry a frontend-generated operation_id and are broadcast instead of replied to the originating client_id, so a client that reconnects mid-cleanup still receives them. A BranchCleanupOperationStore keeps the latest snapshot per cleanup surface, letting a reconnected client pull the in-flight state back through sync_branch_cleanup, and the initial per-client sync replays live operations so a fully reloaded page recovers too. The frontend no longer renders a dropped socket as a cleanup failure, re-syncs on reconnect, ignores superseded operations, and releases the backend snapshot when the result is closed. All five acceptance criteria are met. Canonical verification record vrr-99d1928c9eff4641b5b7c8c4db3a2f85 PASS with 6 of 6 commands exit 0, including 3028 lib tests, 118 embedded_web bin contract tests, 16 branch cleanup protocol and reconnect tests, and a headed Chromium E2E green on both dark and light themes with zero console or page errors. PR #4458 merged into develop on green CI.
